29317-there-will-be-school-tomorrow.title: There Will Be School Tomorrow
29317-there-will-be-school-tomorrow.creator: Unknown
29317-there-will-be-school-tomorrow.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There was no one out on the streets. From inside the houses came the sound of surprise and agony. After a time there was silence. The robots came out of the houses and went walking back to the schools. In the cities and in the country there was the strange and sudden silence of tragedy.

arxiv-2108-00196.title: QCD phase transition drives supernova explosion of a very massive star
arxiv-2108-00196.creator: Tobias Fischer
arxiv-2108-00196.description: Abstract The nature of core-collapse supernova (SN) explosions is yet incompletely understood. The present article revisits the scenario in which the release of latent heat due to a first-order phase transition, from normal nuclear matter to the quark–gluon plasma, liberates the necessary energy to explain observed SN explosions.

arxiv-2212-02215.title: An On-Chip Continuous Wave Terahertz Spectrometer
arxiv-2212-02215.creator: James Seddon, Chris Graham, Marie Georgiades, Cyril Renaud, Alywn Seeds
arxiv-2212-02215.description: Abstract Continuous Wave (CW) Terahertz spectroscopy enabled by photomixing is a promising high precision spectroscopic tool for the examination of a wide variety of samples including biological, chemical, and solid state. However, often it would be of interest to examine isolated samples free from bulk effects that broaden spectral features.

arxiv-2302-00101.title: AstroPix: CMOS pixels in space
arxiv-2302-00101.creator: Jeremy S. Perkins
arxiv-2302-00101.description: Abstract Space-based gamma-ray telescopes such as the Fermi Large Area Telescope have used single sided silicon strip detectors to measure the position of charged particles produced by incident gamma rays with high resolution. At energies in the Compton regime and below, two dimensional position information within a single detector is required.

arxiv-2404-06528.title: Deterministic and Stochastic Geometric Mechanics for Hall MHD
arxiv-2404-06528.creator: Darryl D. Holm, Ruiao Hu, Oliver D. Street
arxiv-2404-06528.description: Abstract We derive new models of stochastic Hall magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) by using a symmetry-reduced stochastic Euler-Poincaré variational principle. The new stochastic Hall MHD theory has potential applications for uncertainty quantification and data assimilation in space plasma (space weather) and solar physics.

arxiv-2407-15743.title: Cache-Aided MIMO Communications: DoF Analysis and Transmitter Optimization The authors are affiliated with the University of Oulu, Finland. Emails: {firstname.lastname@oulu.fi}. This work was supported by Infotech Oulu and by the Research Council of Finland under grants no. 343586 (CAMAIDE) and 3462
arxiv-2407-15743.creator: Mohammad NaseriTehrani, MohammadJavad Salehi, and Antti Tölli
arxiv-2407-15743.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mohammad NaseriTehrani, MohammadJavad Salehi, and Antti Tölli. Cache-aided MIMO communications aims to jointly exploit both coded caching (CC) and spatial multiplexing gains to enhance communication efficiency. In this paper, we first analyze the achievable degrees of freedom (DoF) in a MIMO-CC system with CC gain t t , where a server with L L transmit antennas communicates with K K users, each equipped with G G receive antennas.

arxiv-2409-18258.title: Capping effects on spin and charge excitations in parent and superconducting Nd 1-x Sr x NiO 2
arxiv-2409-18258.creator: S. Fan, H. LaBollita, Q. Gao, N. Khan, Y. Gu, T. Kim, J. Li, V. Bhartiya, Y. Li, W. Sun, J. Yang, S. Yan, A. Barbour, X. Zhou, A. Cano, F. Bernardini, Y. Nie, Z. Zhu, V. Bisogni, C. Mazzoli, A. S. Botana, J. Pelliciari
arxiv-2409-18258.description: Abstract Superconductivity in infinite layer nickelates Nd 1-x Sr x NiO 2 has so far been achieved only in thin films raising questions on the role of substrates and interfaces. Given the challenges associated with their synthesis it is imperative to identify their intrinsic properties.

pmc-10590973.title: Urbanization associates with restricted gut microbiome diversity and delayed maturation in infants
pmc-10590973.creator: Francesco Morandini, Kevin Perez, Loic Brot, Sidy Mohammed Seck, Laurence Tibère, Jean-Pierre Grill, Enguerran Macia, Philippe Seksik
pmc-10590973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SummaryAlterations of the microbiome are linked to increasingly common diseases such as obesity, allergy, and inflammatory bowel disease. Post-industrial lifestyles are thought to contribute to the gut microbiome alterations that cause or aggravate these diseases. Comparing communities across the industrialization spectrum can reveal associations between gut microbiome alterations and lifestyle and health, and help pinpoint which specific aspect of the post-industrial lifestyle is linked to microbiome alterations.

pmc-11332596.title: Calcium‐mediated DAD in membrane potentials and triggered activity in atrial myocytes of ETV1f / fMyHCCre /+ mice
pmc-11332596.creator: Li‐Hua Fang, Qian Chen, Xian‐Lu Cheng, Xiao‐Qian Li, Tian Zou, Jian‐Quan Chen, Guo‐Jian Xiang, Qiao Xue, Yang Li, Jian‐Cheng Zhang
pmc-11332596.description: The E‐twenty‐six variant 1 (ETV1)‐dependent transcriptome plays an important role in atrial electrical and structural remodelling and the occurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF), but the underlying mechanism of ETV1 in AF is unclear. In this study, cardiomyocyte‐specific ETV1 knockout (ETV1f/fMyHCCre/+, ETV1‐CKO) mice were constructed to observe the susceptibility to AF and the underlying mechanism in AF associated with ETV1‐CKO mice.

pmc-11665308.description: lización de los nódulos pulmonares para el diagnóstico intraoperatorio, así como garantizar un margen oncológico en la resección pulmonar segmentaria. La navegación electromagnética endoscópica permite guiar instrumentos endoscópicos hacia lesiones pulmonares utilizando un sistema de seguimiento electromagnético basado en imágenes preoperatorias de tomografía computarizada.

pmc-11716158.title: The association of coronary artery calcium progression and cognitive function in midlife ‐ The Coronary Artery Risk Development In Young Adults (CARDIA) Study
pmc-11716158.creator: Masayuki Teramoto, Tina D Hoang, Stephen Sidney, James G Terry, Mark J Pletcher, Gregory M Marcus, Thomas Hoffman, Kristine Yaffe
pmc-11716158.description: BackgroundLittle is known about the impact of coronary artery calcium (CAC) and its progression on cognitive function in midlife, a time of importance for cognitive aging.MethodsIn CARDIA, CAC was measured using computed tomography at years 15 (baseline), 20 and 25.

pmc-12472378.title: Exploring the Intestinal Microbiota Profile in Prostate Cancer Patients and Healthy Controls
pmc-12472378.creator: Giovanna Cocomazzi, Annacandida Villani, Gandino Mencarelli, Viviana Contu, Daniele De Ruvo, Edy Virgili, Francesco Marino, Giorgio Maria Baldini, Elena Binda, Lodovico Parmegiani, Walter Ciampaglia, Lorenzo Capone, Francesco Perri, Antonio Cisternino, Valerio Pazienza, Concetta Panebianco, Pramod G
pmc-12472378.description: Recent studies suggest a role for the gut microbiota in the onset, progression, and prognosis of prostate cancer (PCa), one of the most common neoplasms in males. PCa screening relies on PSA testing, whose usefulness remains controversial due to its low specificity.

pmc-12880115.title: Burden and trend of cardiovascular diseases in youths aged 0–19 years in China, Asia, and the world, with forecasts to 2036: a systematic analysis of the global burden of disease study 2021
pmc-12880115.creator: Jin Yu, Shanshan Zhu, Zeping Wang, Yongyao Shen, Sheng Ji, Yongjin Guo, Liying Jiang
pmc-12880115.description: ObjectiveTo combat the harmful impacts of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) on public health, it is crucial to understand the epidemiologic features and disease burden. The study aims to identify the trends of CVDs burden in youths aged 0–19 years from 1990 to 2021 across the global, Asian, and Chinese contexts to inform more effective strategies and actions.

pmc-13077448.title: Benchmarking speech biomarkers of Alzheimer's against cognitive and neural measures
pmc-13077448.creator: Ivan Caro, Gonzalo Pérez, Joaquín Valdés Bize, Joaquín Ponferrada, Franco J Ferrante, Alejandro Sosa Welford, Lara Gauder, Loreto Olavarría, Fernando Henríquez, Teresita Ramos, Cristina Besnier, Luciana Ferrer, Maria Luisa Gorno‐Tempini, Andrea Slachevsky, Agustín Ibañez, Adolfo M García
pmc-13077448.description: INTRODUCTIONDigital speech biomarkers (DSBs) support the detection and monitoring of Alzheimer's disease (AD) in Latinos. However, they have not been benchmarked against standard cognitive and neuroimaging measures, missing a critical validation milestone.METHODSThirty‐three AD patients and 33 healthy controls completed verbal fluency tasks, episodic memory and executive tests, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) (volume) and functional MRI (fMRI) (connectivity) scans.

pmc-13347947.title: Essential lncRNAs in the human transcriptome
pmc-13347947.creator: Wen-Wei Liang, Simon J Mueller, Sydney K Hart, Hans-Hermann Wessels, Alejandro Méndez-Mancilla, Akash Sookdeo, Olivia Choi, Christina M Caragine, Alba Corman, Lu Lu, Olena Kolumba, Breanna Williams, Neville E Sanjana
pmc-13347947.description: SummaryMammalian genomes host a diverse array of RNAs, including protein-coding and noncoding transcripts. However, the functional roles of most long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) remain elusive. Using RNA-targeting CRISPR-Cas13 screens, we probed how the loss of ∼5,500 lncRNAs impacts cell fitness across five human cell lines and identified 788 lncRNAs with context-specific or broad essentiality.

pmc-13384296.title: First epidemiological characterization of Leishmania tarentolae in sand flies collected in southern France and Corsica Island
pmc-13384296.creator: Stefania Porcelli, Julie Sevila, Nalia Mekarnia, Anne-Laure Baňuls, Pascal Delaunay, Aurélien Mercier, Bruno Mathieu, Stéphane Goldblum, Arezki Izri, Loïc Favennec, Fano Randrianambinintsoa, Jérome Depaquit, Jorian Prudhomme, Florence Robert-Gangneux
pmc-13384296.description: Leishmania tarentolae, a reptile-associated parasite, is poorly documented in France. This study provides the first molecular survey of L. tarentolae in sand flies across mainland France and Corsica (2023–2024), combining morphological and molecular vector identification with PCR-based parasite detection. A total of 2,731 female sand flies were collected, and 412 unfed pools and 132 blood-fed females were analysed.

pmc-13568397.title: VARE: Geometry-Anchored Bearing and Range Stabilization for USV Recovery
pmc-13568397.creator: Chen Chen, Ze Sun, Jiale Zhang, Peng Zhang, Junwei Dong, Run Qian, Dan Wang
pmc-13568397.description: Reliable unmanned surface vehicle (USV) recovery requires near-field maritime remote sensing outputs that remain stable during the final approach. Planar fiducial geometry provides metric pose estimates, but its depth channel is sensitive to corner-localization noise, apparent marker shrinkage, glare, reflection, and vessel vibration.
